kinetrix_combat.settings.title: Kinetrix Combat: bars and tray
kinetrix_combat.settings.style.clock.tip: Gold, like the vanilla clock. Shields stay steel grey.
Dark orange, like a medieval RPG. Shields stay steel grey.
kinetrix_combat.settings.sides.tip: Shields above armour on the left and energy above hunger on the right, or the other way round.
kinetrix_combat.settings.arrows.tip: Left of the hotbar while a bow is in hand: an arrow and how many you carry.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.dodges.tip: R + A or R + D: a side step out of the way (with a sword or a bow it knocks an arrow aside).
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.rolls.tip: R + W or R + S: a roll forward or back.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.slide.tip: C while sprinting: a slide (C held: crawl on after it).
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.slideAttac: The left button while sliding with a sword, an axe or a bow: a turn round with a blow at everyone near.
The right button while sliding with a bow: a whole turn down onto one knee, drawing; let go: 3 arrows at once, side by side, and up. Creep only, the camera free. 20 s cooldown.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.vault.tip: R + W at point blank: a roll over the mob's back.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.kick.tip: W and Space down, R at a mob: the vault, a turn and a spinning kick.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.dive.tip: W and Space down, R with no mob near: a dive forward into a roll.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.dash.tip: G with a sword (tapped): a lunge forward with a crit. 30 s cooldown.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.finisher.t: The left button at point blank to a mob with 20% health: a sword stabs it in the belly, quick; an axe chops from above.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.guard.tip: The right button with a sword or an axe: the block, in time a parry.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.fallRoll.t: R held while falling: the tuck and a roll on landing (less damage).
The right button in a jump, a fall or just past a drop's edge: one hand catches the ledge.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.autoHang.t: Ctrl + W + C at a drop: turn round and lower yourself into the hang.
Hanging, A or D held: hops along the edge one after another. Look at another edge: it lights up green if you can reach it, red if it is too far; Space leaps there.
G with a bow: a slide back onto a knee and 3 arrows one after another, 10 s cooldown. With marks the arrows go at the marked in turn.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.legolas.ti: R at a full draw: shots with spins, one after another, while the right button is held. 12 s cooldown from its end.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.kickCutsce: During the kick the camera goes behind you and the view narrows as if time slowed.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.firstPerso: In first person both arms are seen in every attack, as on a ledge: the mod's attacks, the left button's blows (Better Combat's too), G's spins as before. Off: vanilla's view of the held item.
kinetrix_combat.ledge.no_room: No room to climb up there
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.fastRun.ti: Ctrl held while running: 7 blocks a second, eats 1% of the energy a second.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.rollKick.t: Ctrl, W and Space down, R at a mob: a flip over it, a kick into its back, a roll back away from it.
G with an axe: four turns, the axe in both hands, carried forward the way the camera looks (A, S, D do nothing), hitting everything round. The right button and G held with 3 to 6 mobs about: the axe combo.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.plunge.tip: Falling with a sword or an axe: the blade goes into the ground on landing, 20% less fall damage, 1 HP to everything round.
kinetrix_combat.menu.title: Kinetrix Combat: mechanics and attacks
kinetrix_combat.menu.hint: The keys of every move and a switch for each. Hover a name for more.
kinetrix_combat.menu.look.tip: Energy colour, shield icon, sides, arrow counter, cooldown tray.
kinetrix_combat.settings.tray.tip: Bottom right: the strikes with a cooldown the weapon in hand makes, each with its icon, key and bar. The bar fills while the strike recharges and is full when it is ready.
Hold G with a sword: turns, the flat of the blade hitting all about, up to 3 while held (each extra +5 energy). While turning, mobs' blows are parried (not a boss's) and arrows and fireballs fly back. No stun: walk any way. 20 s cooldown.
%1$s with an axe, hold for up to 5 turns
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.slideAttac: %4$s while sliding, sword, axe or bow
%5$s while sliding with a bow, let go to shoot
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.rollKick.k: Ctrl + W + Space + %2$s at a mob
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.plunge.key: falling with a sword or an axe
%1$s with a bow, held for more
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.crossbow.t: Left button with a crossbow, each click the next blow: a push forward, a turn clockwise with a slap, a turn the other way with a blow onto the spine; the fourth: a hop back into a crouch and a shot if it is loaded, else a dash back. A pause starts over from the push.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.crossbow.k: %4$s with a crossbow, click after click
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.vault.keys: %2$s + W at point blank to a mob
%5$s in a jump at an edge
hanging A / D, Space to the edge looked at
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.attackCame: In first person the camera goes behind you for the volley at the marked (it aims and turns you by itself) and comes back after it. Off: it stays in first person.
a view from behind in the marked volley
kinetrix_combat.ledge.too_far: That edge is out of reach
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.bowMarks.t: The right button held, the left one on a mob: a mark (up to 8, for a minute; again to take it off, with Shift all of them). Let go of the right button at the full draw: an arrow at each marked mob in sight; once in 25 s.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.bowMarks.k: %5$s + %4$s on a mob, let go of %5$s
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.crossbowAb: G with a crossbow: loaded, a hop back and 3 arrows spread; not loaded, a turn round with the crossbow at arm's length (hits everyone about and flings them away) and a shove. 10 s cooldown.
%1$s with a crossbow, held: the fan
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.crossbowRo: Hold the right button with a crossbow and press R: roll after roll with a shot after each, the way WASD points (back with none). Let go of the right button or put the crossbow away to stop. 12 s cooldown from the end.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.airSpin.ti: A sword in hand, W + Space + G held: up head down, 5 turns of the blade the way you look (no steering), hitting all around as the usual turns; down to the ground into a slide of 3.5 blocks, as Ctrl + C, and up. 45 s cooldown, 25 energy.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.axeCombo.t: An axe in hand, 3 to 6 mobs within 8 blocks in sight (not behind walls): hold the right button and G: a blow for each of them in turn, whirls and chops taking turns, each losing 80% of its greatest health (not bosses); untouchable meanwhile. 40 s cooldown, 20 energy.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.throw.tip: A sword or an axe in hand: hold the left and the right button to draw back (walking slowly), let go of either to throw; it flies as a trident, the further the longer it was drawn (up to 1 s). Auto-aim: a red cross on the mob near the crosshair, the throw goes into it. The thrown weapon glows, to be found. A hit mob has it stuck half in: the left or the right button at point blank pulls it out (a little damage, a short stun), and a weak mob is finished at once: the sword under the ribs, the axe from above. Killed by the throw, the weapon falls and sticks in the ground; walk over it to pick it up. 2.5 s cooldown.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.chainFinis: A sword in hand, 2 to 6 mobs about at half their health or under. Ctrl + W + Space + LMB: a leap onto the first from the front, the blade over its shoulder into its back; the next within 7 blocks: over onto its back, turning round, the blade into its head; then from the front again, in turn, up to 6; then a back flip and a roll. After the usual finisher on LMB the chain goes on by itself if such mobs are about. The camera from behind. 10 energy each, 90 s cooldown.

kinetrix_combat.settings.move.bowHail.ti: Hold G with a bow: a long slide back and 5 to 10 quick arrows, spread out. 40 s cooldown.
kinetrix_combat.settings.move.crossbowFa: Hold G with a crossbow: an arrow loads every 0.5 s (8 at most), let go and they all fly at once like a shotgun. 40 s cooldown.

kinetrix_combat.guide.text:
§6The fight§r
The blow, the damage and the movement are vanilla's: the mod only adds moves to them. Every player has the basic moves from the start: the fast run (Ctrl), the rolls and dodges (R + WASD), the vault over a mob (R + W at point blank), the jump with a kick (W + Space + R at a mob), the slide (Ctrl + C) and the attack out of it (LMB), the soft landing (R while falling), the block (RMB with a sword or an axe), the finisher (LMB at a weakened mob), the crossbow's blows (LMB), the ledge.

§6Moves and the wheel§r
The other moves are written in scrolls: found in dungeon and village chests, given by the trainer villager. Read one (RMB) and the move is learned. Only the moves on the wheel work, 6 at most (K, the Moves tab). Hold Z for the wheel: point and click. Another weapon's moves are grey. Any move can have a key of its own (the Keys tab).

§6The energy bar§r
Every move and the fast run take from the bar (100). Empty, a move does not start.
Copper (at the start): everything costs 3 times as much. Bronze: twice. Brass: as usual. The rank goes up with endurance scrolls the trainer gives for a chain of tasks: bronze first, then brass.
Armour weighs a little: full armour (20 points) costs 10 % more.

§6How it fills§r
By itself: 4 a second unless you are hungry. In a fight, running or in a move, half as fast; standing still or sneaking, twice as fast; well fed (full hunger and saturation), 1.5 times as fast. Filling takes hunger.
Cooked food gives +25 at once. A golden apple: 30 s of filling twice as fast. An enchanted golden apple: 45 s of an endless bar and cooldowns halved.

§6Shields§r
The block takes shields (10). One comes back every 4 s for 5 energy.
